title: PBMC of patient #7 before TTF treatment
treatment_protocol_ch1: Blood was draw before and one month after TTField plus TMZ treatment started
growth_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) were obtained from blood by density gradient centrifugation (Ficoll-Hypaque) and cryopreserved at liquid nitrogen until processed.
extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen PBMC samples were quickly taken from liquid nitrogen and counted 1.2e4 cells putting on a 10x Chromium instrument (10x Genomics) to export labeled RNA fragments using Chromium Single Cell 3′ v3 Reagent Kit (PN-1000075).
Single-cell RNA-seq libraries were prepared using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ v3 library construction Kit (PN-1000075)
End repair, A-tailing, adaptor ligation
data_processing: Conversion of the raw sequencing data from the bcl to fastq format and the subsequent alignment to the reference genome GRCh38 (GENCODE v.24) and gene count were performed using the cellranger software (10x Genomics, version 4.0.0) with the command cellranger mkfastq, the STAR aligner, and the command cellranger count, respectively.
Results from all libraries and batches were pooled together using the command cellranger aggr without normalization for dead cells as it will be handled downstream.
UMAP coordinates calculations were performed by using Seurat package (3.2.2), using top 75 PCA principle components as input features.
Cell clustering was  done using graph-based clustering approach implemented in the Seurat package(3.2.2) with command FindClusters
Genome_build: hg38
